title: Visual second pass: Remotes page and folder picker in foreman's row grammar
body:
Visual second pass on the Settings > Remotes page and the remote folder picker, to bring them in line with foreman's own conventions. The human reviewed the running app, chose the direction below from a design audit, and wants the page to stop looking like a different app. This is paint, layout and hints. The edit model (Draft, commit, validation), key handling semantics, probes and the folder model stay as they are.
Files: src/remotes_pane.rs, src/remote_browse_ui.rs, src/remote_dir_prompt.rs, src/remote_install.rs (agents line only), src/settings_menu.rs (footer). Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (UI sections; update them to match what you build). Read docs/settings-menu.md and docs/theme-system.md first.
Blocked by: Fix review findings on creating a folder on a Remote
The conventions (each is evidenced in the code; match them, do not invent new ones):
- sel_bg is a one-row selection wash (theme.rs: "Selected-row wash"), never a container fill. Containers use the surface ladder plus a 1px border (hover_menu::show popup: th.bg + border, radius 4; wells use desk_bg as in dirpicker.rs and appearance.rs).
- Settings rows have one grammar (settings_menu.rs draw_pane / draw_control, appearance.rs PAD / ROW_H / row_text): label 13 pt, dim 11 pt description under it, control right-aligned, row height 46, left pad 18. Editing a text value swaps the right-hand value for a 24 px TextEdit in the same row; it never opens a block.
- Controls are 1 px outline chips, radius 4, 12.5 pt, border_focus when selected or hovered, no fill (Kind::Choice, Kind::Action, the stepper).
- Section headers are small dim caps with a hairline (appearance.rs section_header; hover_menu Entry::Header).
- UI text is proportional; monospace only for machine strings (a target, a path, a command).
- Hints live in the settings footer, not in the pane.
Decided by the human, build exactly this:
A. Remove the sel_bg-filled form block in remotes_pane::render_form and the same slab in remote_dir_prompt::show. No container fill for the edit state.
B. Record edit in row grammar. A collapsed Remote keeps its content, at left pad 18, and its sel_bg wash (radius 4) covers the WHOLE item (name line, status line, agents line), not just the top 42 px. Editing a Remote expands it in place into ordinary settings rows on the plain pane background, marked only by a 2 px border_focus bar on the left edge (the rail's idiom). Rows, top to bottom:
   - a header row: the Remote's name on the left (or "New Remote"), and "save" / "cancel" as lowercase small buttons in the row's right-hand cluster, where delete / keep already sit. Enter still saves and Esc still cancels from any field. The validation error line stays, in the danger colour, directly under the header row with its reserved height.
   - Name: label left, text field right.
   - Target: label left, text field right (monospace value). The ~/.ssh/config suggestion strip keeps its reserved line under this row.
   - Shell: label left, an OUTLINE choice chip right (the Kind::Choice look), not a filled button.
   - a section header "PROJECT DIRECTORIES" in the small-caps header style, replacing the dim caption.
   - one row per mapping: label = the Project folder's name, description = the seat-PC path elided from the front (full path on hover), control = the Directory field with a "(home)" placeholder when blank, and "clear" as a lowercase small button at the far right.
C. Folder picker (remote_browse_ui.rs Browser::show): sits directly under the focused Directory row (in the dir prompt: directly under the Directory field). No fill; a 1 px border that turns border_focus when the list has the keyboard. Rows 22 px (as now), selection shown by the sel_bg wash only (drop the extra marker glyph: one encoding, not two), hover as the launcher rows do, folder names in the proportional UI font, the breadcrumb path in monospace. The action row reads "+ New folder" and must read as an action, not a folder (not by colour alone).
D. Hints: remove the in-pane "Remotes" title and the in-pane hint line (the settings title band already says Remotes). The pane supplies the footer text, and the footer changes with what has focus (browsing rows, editing a field, the folder list, the new-folder name field, a confirm). The footer must never contradict the pane: today it says "Tab rail/pane - Esc close" while Tab moves between fields and Esc cancels the edit. Give the settings menu one hook by which a custom-body pane supplies its footer string, and use the same hook for the Keybindings pane, which has the same duplicate title and hint. Every footer string fits one line at the settings window's minimum width.
E. Directory prompt (remote_dir_prompt.rs): same picker, slab removed, the field directly in the popup on the popup surface, the open / cancel buttons right-aligned on one line. Position and scrim unchanged.
F. Small alignments: "+ Add Remote" uses the row height and left pad of the other rows; the agents line keeps its reserved height, with its install / retry buttons in the right-hand control cluster of that line rather than inside running text.
Keep, do not change: the Draft model and key semantics; in-row delete and install confirms; every reserved fixed-height line (no layout shift anywhere); 22 px folder rows and the breadcrumb; monospace for target, path and command; lowercase small buttons in row clusters; the separator and message line; Ctrl+N for new folder; the first-Esc-returns-to-field rule.
Constraints: theme tokens only (no Color32 literals, no new tokens); it must look right with a theme whose sel_bg is strong (the human's theme makes sel_bg a saturated orange) and with the default faint one; nothing is clipped at PANE_MIN_W and the settings window's minimum height; one thing looks focused at a time.
Tests: the layout tests for this pane (the Laid assertions, hint_fits, the minimum-width and no-jump tests in settings_menu.rs and remotes_pane.rs) will need to move with the layout; keep every property they protect (fits at minimum width, nothing moves when a result arrives, buttons visible with an error, every agents line fits) and add: the selected item's wash covers all of its lines; no rect in the edit state is filled with sel_bg except a selected folder row; the footer string for each focus state fits and matches the keys that work.
Done when:
- the above is built and the full test suite passes
- the final report lists exactly which states the human should look at in the running app (collapsed row selected, edit with no mappings, edit with a mapping and the folder list open, list focused, new-folder name field, validation error, delete confirm, install confirm, the dir prompt), and anything that could not be made to fit the conventions and why
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent
